verdict.rationale: AI inbox triage is a fair question for an email service, but the pack shows no Fastmail AI auto-labeling, categorization, or attention-surfacing feature. The relevant evidence is user-defined Filters & Rules and spam filtering, which are adjacent controls, not AI triage. Community users say they miss Gmail's auto-categorization and use Sanebox as an outside workaround, which earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
